Question:
Can you help me find the top 5 countries whose players have the highest average of their individual average runs per match across all seasons? Specifically, for each player, calculate their average runs per match over all matches they played, then compute the average of these player averages for each country, and include these country batting averages in the result.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH player_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        p.country_name,
        bb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pm.match_id = bb.match_id
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
        AND (bb.striker = pm.player_id OR bb.non_striker = pm.player_id)
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, p.country_name, bb.match_id
),
player_avg_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        player_id,
        total_runs * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY country_name, player_id, total_runs
),
country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        country_name,
        AVG(avg_runs_per_match) as avg_of_player_avgs
    FROM player_avg_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY country_name
    ORDER BY avg_of_player_avgs DESC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT country_name, ROUND(avg_of_player_avgs, 2) as avg_runs_per_match
FROM country_avg

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker AS player_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CAST(bs.runs_scored AS INTEGER)), 0) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker
),

    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played
    FROM player_match pm

),
player_avg_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player_id,
        pr.total_runs,
        pm.matches_played,
        CASE WHEN pm.matches_played > 0 THEN pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pm.matches_played ELSE 0 END AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    JOIN player_matches pm ON pr.player_id = pm.player_id
),
player_country_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country_name,
        AVG(par.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_avg_runs par
    JOIN player p ON par.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country_name
)
